catalog.name: Gmail
catalog.description: Trigger an agent when mail arrives. Send replies. Search your inbox.
catalog.author: Myra

actions.label: Create a draft
actions.summary: Save the result as a Gmail draft (no send)

config.label: Google OAuth client ID
config.description: Shipped Myra client by default. Desktop 'installed app' OAuth client. Override to bring your own Google Cloud client.

config.label: Google OAuth client secret
config.description: For desktop/installed-app clients Google treats this as non-confidential (PKCE is the real proof). Stored in the OS keychain.

config.label: Gmail refresh token
config.description: Set automatically by Connect — leave blank. Stored in the server's cross-platform secret store and injected back at runtime.

config.label: Myra server URL
config.description: The local Myra server. The connector creates + launches cards via its /rpc endpoint (add_card → launch_agent).

config.label: Server bearer token
config.description: Only needed if the server runs with MYRA_SERVER_TOKEN set. Leave blank when /rpc is open on localhost (dev default).

config.label: Default agent preset
config.description: Agent to run for triggered cards when a rule doesn't set its own `agentId`. Any installed preset id (e.g. claude, opencode, echo).

config.label: Working directory
config.description: Optional repo/dir the triggered agent runs in. Leave blank for the card's default run home.

config.label: Base Gmail search
config.description: Server-side Gmail query prefilter (from:, subject:, has-text, label:). Regex is applied locally — see RULES.

config.label: Poll interval (seconds)
config.description: How often to check Gmail. 60s is polite. Keep >=30.

config.label: Trigger rules (JSON)
config.description: JSON array. Each rule: { name, from?, subjectContains?, bodyContains?, regex?, regexField?, agentId?, prompt, requireReview? }. First matching rule wins. `prompt` may use {{subject}} {{from}} {{body}} {{snippet}} {{id}}.

config.label: Hold triggered cards for review
config.description: Safety default ON. Cards created from email land paused for you to approve before the agent runs. Turn off only once you trust your rules — email content is untrusted input.

config.label: Max triggers / hour
config.description: Loop guard. Prevents an inbox flood (or a self-reply loop) from spawning runaway agent runs.

config.label: Email the result when a card finishes
config.description: When ON, a finished card (status=done) emails its result via your Gmail. Reply-to-thread when the card came from an email.

config.label: Result recipient
config.description: Address to email finished-card results to. Leave blank to reply into the originating email thread only.

config.label: Dry run (log, don't act)
config.description: Safety default ON. Matches and would-be sends are logged, no card is created and no email is sent. Flip OFF to go live.
